repos.name: ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis
repos.description: LLM 驱动的多市场股票智能分析系统：多源行情、实时新闻、决策看板与自动推送，支持零成本定时运行。  LLM-powered multi-market stock analysis system with multi-source market data, real-time news, decision dashboard, automated notifications, and cost-free scheduled runs.
repos.one_liner: An LLM-powered multi-market stock analysis system providing real-time news, market data, and automated decision dashboards.
bullets: Built with Python, integrating multi-source financial data APIs and LLM-based sentiment analysis.
Features automated decision-making dashboards and push notifications for market alerts.
Designed for quantitative research and automated daily stock market monitoring.
Supports cost-effective, scheduled execution for continuous financial tracking.

repos.name: vercel-labs/agent-browser
repos.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
repos.one_liner: A high-performance browser automation CLI specifically designed for AI agents to interact with the web.
bullets: Written in Rust for high-speed, reliable browser control and memory safety.
Provides a standardized interface for LLMs to navigate, click, and extract data from complex web pages.
Enables autonomous agentic workflows for web-based research and data gathering.
Acts as a critical infrastructure component for building robust AI-driven web automation agents.

repos.name: qybaihe/bla
repos.description: 🛡️ BLA (Blind LLM Agents) — Adversarial defense shield that protects binaries, Electron apps, JS bundles, Python, and WebAssembly against AI reverse-engineering agents like REA. Poison -> Exhaust -> Hallucinate.
repos.one_liner: An adversarial defense shield designed to protect software binaries and codebases from AI-driven reverse-engineering agents.
bullets: Implements defensive techniques like poisoning and resource exhaustion to neutralize malicious AI agents.
Supports protection for diverse targets including Electron apps, JS bundles, Python, and WebAssembly.
Addresses the emerging security threat of automated AI reverse-engineering tools.
Provides a critical security layer for proprietary codebases and sensitive software infrastructure.

repos.name: sarpstar/cinecode
repos.description: Films made with code. Short films, long YouTube videos, ads, explainers and music videos: an AI coding agent writes the script, builds every frame in code, designs the sound and hands you an MP4.
repos.one_liner: An AI coding agent that generates complete short films, ads, and explainers by writing code to build every frame.
bullets: Utilizes an agentic AI architecture to script, design, and render visual content programmatically.
Automates the entire video production pipeline from script generation to final MP4 output.
Demonstrates advanced agentic capabilities in creative media and automated content generation.
Useful for rapid prototyping of visual explainers and automated marketing content.

repos.name: igor-alexandrov/tabletist
repos.description: A fast, native database client for PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite. Written in Rust with egui; runs on Linux, macOS and Windows.
repos.one_liner: A fast, native database client for PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite written in Rust.
bullets: Built with Rust and the egui framework for high performance and cross-platform compatibility.
Provides a lightweight, native GUI experience for managing multiple database types.
Optimized for developers and data professionals requiring fast, local database interaction.
Serves as a modern, efficient infrastructure tool for database administration and query execution.
